targets.criterion: strongest B2/C1 end-to-end p50 improvement >= 10% with positive paired CI
targets.estimand: direct B2-minus-C1 post-resize-to-result paired latency; positive favors C1
targets.reason: The positive paired interval is stable but the measured improvement is below 10%.

targets.criterion: sustained camera throughput >= 20% higher or materially lower true frame-delivery-to-result with matched quality
targets.estimand: separate successful Release physical-camera sessions; not the serial paired run
targets.reason: The successful historical Release sessions are cadence-limited at about 30 FPS and C1 has a higher, not lower, frame-delivery p50. A fresh R7 camera attempt received zero callbacks and is not substituted for this evidence.

targets.criterion: frontend improvement >= 2x, zero full RGB, zero element-by-element CPU copy, and end-to-end improvement >= 5% with positive paired CI
targets.reason: The zero-resource conditions pass, but neither the >=2x frontend nor >=5% end-to-end threshold passes.

targets.criterion: another comparably strong result explicitly accepted by hostile technical review
targets.reason: No alternative result is pre-accepted; Sol must independently decide whether any measured result is genuinely equivalent.

interpretation: Before hostile review, none of the four preregistered competition targets is met. This is an evidence result, not permission to weaken thresholds or reframe the comparison.
